# BanJoey

> The BanJoey is a one-of-a-kind percussion instrument invented and handmade by Tampa Bay drummer Joey Interrante. A banjo shell on a cajón box, played with a bass pedal, with a cymbal on top and snare wires underneath.

Joey built the BanJoey because nothing on the market had the sound he wanted, then refined it over years of live shows. The name came from bandmate Gale Trippsmith, who introduced him onstage as "Joey playing a BanJoey."

## Pages
- [BanJoey](https://banjoey.com/): What the BanJoey is, performance videos, photos, and how to contact Joey.

## Watch
- [YouTube @banjoeydrummer](https://www.youtube.com/@banjoeydrummer): BanJoey performance videos.

## About Joey Interrante
- Professional drummer based in Tampa Bay, Florida, with 50 years behind the kit.
- Plays live across Tampa Bay and Florida, including with Gale Trippsmith (Gale and Joey) and the Kid Royal Band.
- Live shows and booking: https://joeydrums.com
- Remote drum tracks and Tampa Bay studio sessions: https://hippocketstudios.com
